body.assistant_text:
I’ve prepared “Staff absence” for your approval on the card; it has not been saved.

- It reduces weekly support capacity by **about 10 tickets per week, between 5 and 15**, using your words and figures.
- The reduction applies across the existing staffing options. No other figures, options or goals change.
- Before approving, check that the existing **80 tickets per week** does not already account for staff absence, so the same loss is not counted twice.
